AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted administrator registry entry for privileged snapshot and analytics management.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

email.description: Verified email address of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin entry was last updated.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account profile containing PII (email and display name), strictly isolated to the owner or admin.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: User display name from Google sign-in.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial profile creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update.

SeasonSnapshotMeta.title: SeasonSnapshotMeta
SeasonSnapshotMeta.description: Metadata describing the latest synced 2026/2027 EuroLeague, EuroCup, and LBA Serie A statistical snapshot.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the snapshot; archived snapshots are locked.

lbaRound.description: Latest completed LBA Serie A round number.

totalGames.description: Total completed EuroLeague + EuroCup games included.

teamsCount.description: Total team records stored across team chunks.

playersCount.description: Total player records stored across player chunks.

teamChunksCount.description: Number of documents in season_chunks storing teams.

playerChunksCount.description: Number of documents in season_chunks storing players.

pbpCachedGames.description: Number of EuroLeague/EuroCup games with Play-by-Play coverage.

pbpCoveragePct.description: Percentage of EuroLeague/EuroCup games covered by Play-by-Play.

sourceLastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp of the underlying server sync.

updatedBy.description: UID of the verified admin who persisted this snapshot.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when metadata document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest metadata update.

SeasonSnapshotChunk.title: SeasonSnapshotChunk
SeasonSnapshotChunk.description: Chunked native map array of TeamStats or PlayerStats belonging to a SeasonSnapshotMeta record.

kind.description: Entity type contained in this chunk.

totalChunks.description: Total number of chunks for this kind.

items.description: Bounded native list of up to 250 TeamStats or PlayerStats maps.

updatedBy.description: UID of the verified admin who saved this chunk.

TrafficSnapshot.title: TrafficSnapshot
TrafficSnapshot.description: Persisted aggregated app traffic and anonymized usage telemetry snapshot for the Accessi App dashboard.

uniqueVisitors.description: Bounded list of anonymized visitor hashes (up to 1000).

daily.description: Map of YYYY-MM-DD daily aggregated metrics.

hourly.description: 24-element numeric array representing hits per hour (0..23).

tabViews.description: Map of tab identifier to view count.

interactions.description: Map of interaction action key to count.

devices.description: Breakdown map for Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet.

recentSessions.description: Bounded list of up to 50 recent anonymized session records.

updatedBy.description: UID of the verified admin who synced this traffic snapshot.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial snapshot creation.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Registry of additional administrators authorized to manage season snapshots and traffic backups.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated user profiles created on Google sign-in.

/season_meta/{metaId}.description: Metadata index for the published 2026/2027 EuroLeague, EuroCup, and LBA dataset snapshots.

/season_chunks/{chunkId}.description: Chunked native map arrays of TeamStats and PlayerStats tied to a valid season_meta parent.

/traffic_snapshots/{snapshotId}.description: Admin-managed persistent backup of aggregated Accessi App traffic analytics.
